card.name: Just before words starting with con
card.fires_on: The word or piece right before a word that begins with "con" or "connect", such as Contra Costa, conical, connectivism, Connecticut. Often it is the "Con" start of such a word itself.

modes.label: Start of Con- names
modes.description: The piece "Con" or "con" that begins a longer word like Contra or conical.

modes.description: A small word or comma right before connectivism, Connecticut or connected.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like than, with or to where a con- or connect- word could plausibly come next.

card.writes: It suppresses a next-word guess tied to connect words, so it pushes down the connect family there.
card.plain: It marks spots where the next word may start with "con" or relate to connecting.
